mapper.select: /** * consultantSrch : isry.couns.taskwkschmng.schprecon.mapper.MnthngSchdlMapper : 소속부서 사원 조회 */ SELECT AA.USER_ID AS USER_ID , BB.FLNM_ENCPT AS USER_NM , BB.BRTH_YMD AS BRTH_YMD FROM SAA200 AA , SCA100 BB WHERE 1=1 AND AA.ENFSN_NO = BB.ENFSN_NO AND BB.OGDP_DEPT_CD = #{deptCd}

/** * searchComboDept : isry.couns.taskwkschmng.schprecon.mapper.MnthngSchdlMapper : 소속부서 조회 */ SELECT AA.DEPT_CD AS DEPT_CD , AA.DEPT_NM AS DEPT_NM , AA.INST_NO AS INST_NO , '4' AS INST_TYPE_SE_CD /** 기관유형구분코드 사이버상담(4) **/ FROM SAA300 AA WHERE 1=1 AND AA.INST_NO = '1000000947' /** 청소년사이버상담센터 **/

/** * selectCombo1ListMnthng : isry.couns.taskwkschmng.schprecon.mapper.MnthngSchdlMapper : 메뉴구분코드 조회 */ SELECT AA.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS CD_VALUE , AA.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS CD_NAME FROM SAC100 AA WHERE 1=1 AND AA.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'MNTHNG_SCHDL_INQ_SE_CD'

/** * searchComboHrWork : isry.couns.taskwkschmng.schprecon.mapper.MnthngSchdlMapper : 시간근무유형 구분코드 조회 */ SELECT AA.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS CD_VALUE , AA.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS CD_NAME FROM SAC100 AA WHERE 1=1 AND AA.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'HR_WORK_TYPE_SE_CD'

/** * searchComboOptionTimes : isry.couns.taskwkschmng.schprecon.mapper.MnthngSchdlMapper : 월간 일정 상세/수정 시간대 콤보 조회 */ WITH TEMP AS ( SELECT DISTINCT AA.BGNG_HR || ' ~ ' || AA.END_HR AS TIMES , AA.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO AS BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO , COUNT(BB.USER_ID) AS CUR_CNT FROM AYC110 AA , AYC100 BB WHERE 1=1 AND AA.TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD = #{deptCd} AND AA.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO = BB.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO AND BB.WORK_YMD LIKE #{workYmd} GROUP BY AA.BGNG_HR || ' ~ ' || AA.END_HR,AA.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO ORDER BY 1 ) SELECT DISTINCT AA.BGNG_HR || ' ~ ' || AA.END_HR AS TIMES , AA.BGNG_HR || '-'|| AA.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO || '-' || AA.MBR_NOCS || '-' || NVL(BB.CUR_CNT,'0') AS TIMES_VALUE FROM AYC110 AA , TEMP BB WHERE 1=1 AND AA.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO = BB.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO(+) AND AA.CRTR_YM LIKE SUBSTR(#{workYmd},'0','6') AND AA.TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD = #{deptCd} ORDER BY 1

/** * selectMnthngSchdlList : isry.couns.taskwkschmng.schprecon.mapper.MnthngSchdlMapper : 월간일정 LIST 조회 */ SELECT T3.WORK_YMD AS WORK_YMD , T3.CRTR_YM AS CRTR_YM , T3.USER_ID AS USER_ID , C##RG.DEC_B64(T6.FLNM_ENCPT) AS USER_NM , T3.TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD AS DEPT_CD , T3.BGNG_HR AS BGNG_HR , T3.END_HR AS END_HR , T3.MBR_NOCS AS MBR_NOCS , ( SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE 1=1 AND CMMNS_CD_ID = 'VCATN_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T4.VCATN_SE_CD ) AS VCATN_SE_NM FROM ( SELECT T1.WORK_YMD , T1.USER_ID , T1.TASKWK_SCHDL_SN , T2.TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD , T2.CRTR_YM , T2.BGNG_HR , T2.END_HR , T2.MBR_NOCS , ( SELECT MAX(COPA_INDEX_SN) AS COPA_INDEX_SN FROM AYC130 WHERE USER_ID = T1.USER_ID AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND APLY_SE_CD = '01' AND APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '2' AND T1.WORK_YMD BETWEEN VCATN_BGNG_YMD AND VCATN_END_YMD GROUP BY USER_ID ) AS COPA_INDEX_SN FROM AYC100 T1 /* 근무배정표_일별 */ , AYC110 T2 /* 근무배정표_월별 */ WHERE 1=1 AND T2.CRTR_YM = #{crtrYm} AND T2.TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD = #{deptCd} AND T1.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO = T2.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO ) T3 , AYC130 T4 , SAA200 T5 , SCA100 T6 WHERE 1=1 AND T3.COPA_INDEX_SN = T4.COPA_INDEX_SN(+) AND T5.USER_ID = T3.USER_ID AND T6.ENFSN_NO = T5.ENFSN_NO ORDER BY T3.WORK_YMD, T3.BGNG_HR, C##RG.DEC_B64(T6.FLNM_ENCPT)

/** * selectMnthngSchdlList02 : isry.couns.taskwkschmng.schprecon.mapper.MnthngSchdlMapper : 월간일정 LIST 조회(휴가) */ SELECT T3.WORK_YMD AS WORK_YMD , T3.CRTR_YM AS CRTR_YM , T3.USER_ID AS USER_ID , C##RG.DEC_B64(T6.FLNM_ENCPT) AS USER_NM , T3.TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD AS DEPT_CD , T3.BGNG_HR AS BGNG_HR , T3.END_HR AS END_HR , T3.MBR_NOCS AS MBR_NOCS , ( SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE 1=1 AND CMMNS_CD_ID = 'VCATN_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T4.VCATN_SE_CD ) AS VCATN_SE_NM FROM ( SELECT T1.WORK_YMD , T1.USER_ID , T1.TASKWK_SCHDL_SN , T2.TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD , T2.CRTR_YM , T2.BGNG_HR , T2.END_HR , T2.MBR_NOCS , ( SELECT MAX(COPA_INDEX_SN) AS COPA_INDEX_SN FROM AYC130 WHERE USER_ID = T1.USER_ID AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND APLY_SE_CD = '01' AND APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '2' AND T1.WORK_YMD BETWEEN VCATN_BGNG_YMD AND VCATN_END_YMD GROUP BY USER_ID ) AS COPA_INDEX_SN FROM AYC100 T1 /* 근무배정표_일별 */ , AYC110 T2 /* 근무배정표_월별 */ WHERE 1=1 AND T2.CRTR_YM = #{crtrYm} AND T2.TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD = #{deptCd} AND T1.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO = T2.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO ) T3 , AYC130 T4 , SAA200 T5 , SCA100 T6 WHERE 1=1 AND T3.COPA_INDEX_SN = T4.COPA_INDEX_SN AND T5.USER_ID = T3.USER_ID AND T6.ENFSN_NO = T5.ENFSN_NO ORDER BY T3.WORK_YMD, T3.BGNG_HR, C##RG.DEC_B64(T6.FLNM_ENCPT)

/** * getRowCnt : isry.couns.taskwkschmng.schprecon.mapper.MnthngSchdlMapper : 월간 일정 등록 - 동적 화면 구성을 위한 로우 카운트 */ WITH TEMP AS ( SELECT DISTINCT AA.BGNG_HR || ' ~ ' || AA.END_HR AS TIMES , AA.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO AS BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO , AA.MBR_NOCS AS TOTAL_CNT , COUNT(BB.USER_ID) AS CUR_CNT FROM AYC110 AA , AYC100 BB WHERE 1=1 AND AA.TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD = #{deptCd} AND AA.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO = BB.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO AND BB.WORK_YMD LIKE #{workYmd} AND AA.DEL_YN = 'N' AND BB.DEL_YN = 'N' GROUP BY AA.BGNG_HR || ' ~ ' || AA.END_HR,AA.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO,AA.MBR_NOCS ORDER BY 1 ) SELECT DISTINCT AA.BGNG_HR || ' ~ ' || AA.END_HR AS TIMES , AA.MBR_NOCS AS TOTAL_CNT , AA.CRTR_YM AS CRTR_YM , AA.TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD AS TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD , NVL(BB.CUR_CNT,'0') AS CUR_CNT FROM AYC110 AA , TEMP BB WHERE 1=1 AND AA.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO = BB.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO(+) AND AA.CRTR_YM LIKE SUBSTR(#{workYmd},'0','6') AND AA.TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD = #{deptCd} ORDER BY 1

/** * getTimesForExclDown : isry.couns.taskwkschmng.schprecon.mapper.MnthngSchdlMapper : 월간일정 시간표 */ SELECT AA.BGNG_HR AS TIMES , AA.BGNG_HR||'~'||AA.END_HR AS PERIODS FROM AYC110 AA WHERE 1=1 AND AA.CRTR_YM = #{crtrYm} AND AA.TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD = #{deptCd} ORDER BY AA.BGNG_HR
SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(AA.FLNM_ENCPT) AS CNSLTNT_NM , BB.USER_ID AS CNSLTNT_ID FROM SCA100 AA , SAA200 BB WHERE 1=1 AND AA.ENFSN_NO = BB.ENFSN_NO AND AA.OGDP_DEPT_CD = #{deptCd}
mapper.delete: /** * "deleteDaySchdl" : isry.couns.taskwkschmng.schprecon.mapper.MnthngSchdlMapper : 월간일정 일괄생성 삭제 */ DELETE FROM AYC100 AA /**근무배정표 일별**/ WHERE 1=1 AND AA.WORK_YMD LIKE #{crtrYm} || '%' AND AA.TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD = #{deptCd}
mapper.insert:
SELECT AYC100_SQ01.CURRVAL AS TASKWK_SCHDL_SN FROM DUAL
/** * insertDaySchdl : isry.couns.taskwkschmng.schprecon.mapper.MnthngSchdlMapper : 월간일정 일괄생성 등록 */ INSERT INTO AYC100 AA /** 근무배정표 일별 **/ ( AA.TASKWK_SCHDL_SN , AA.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO , AA.WORK_YMD , AA.TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD , AA.USER_ID , AA.FRST_RGTR_ID , AA.FRST_REG_DT , AA.LAST_MDFR_ID , AA.LAST_MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( AYC100_SQ01.NEXTVAL , ( SELECT A1.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO FROM AYC110 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.CRTR_YM = #{crtrYm} AND A1.TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD = #{deptCd} AND A1.BGNG_HR = #{bgngHr} ) , #{WORK_YMD} , #{deptCd} , #{CNSLTNT_ID} , #{loginId} , SYSDATE , #{loginId} , SYSDATE )

SELECT AYC100_SQ01.CURRVAL AS TASKWK_SCHDL_SN FROM DUAL
/** * insertMnthngSchdl : isry.couns.taskwkschmng.schprecon.mapper.MnthngSchdlMapper : 월간 일정 등록(상담) */ INSERT INTO AYC100 AA /** 근무배정표 일별 **/ ( AA.TASKWK_SCHDL_SN , AA.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO , AA.WORK_YMD , AA.TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD , AA.USER_ID , AA.FRST_RGTR_ID , AA.FRST_REG_DT , AA.LAST_MDFR_ID , AA.LAST_MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( AYC100_SQ01.NEXTVAL , ( SELECT A1.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO FROM AYC110 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.CRTR_YM = #{crtrYm} AND A1.TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD = #{deptCd} AND A1.BGNG_HR = #{BGNG_HR} ) , #{workYmd} , #{deptCd} , #{CNSLTNT_ID} , #{loginId} , SYSDATE , #{loginId} , SYSDATE )
